title: Interplay of Fe and S biogeochemistry shapes in situ iron mineral transformations in contrasting intertidal sediments
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00213C, Paper
Open Access

L. Joëlle Kubeneck, Giulia Fantappiè, Luiza Notini, Katherine A. Rothwell, Laurel K. ThomasArrigo, Ruben Kretzschmar
Using 57Fe-labeled minerals in field incubations, we found lepidocrocite and goethite remained mostly unchanged for 8 weeks in low sulfide Fe-reducing intertidal sediments, but transformed nearly entirely to Fe–sulfides under high sulfide conditions.
